messages:
dmitri: Heads-up — scheduling a Terraform apply tied to release/2026.03.20. Changeset is network (VPC routing + NACL), then IAM service roles, then service route tweaks. Change window 23:00–23:30 UTC. Plan posted: https://ci.redwood/plan/1857502468. Please ack if you can be on-call for rollbacks.

deploy-bot: preflight checks complete. tfsec: no critical findings. drift-check: ok. Remote state lock available. Will create a lock before the first apply.

carla: ack — I'm available. Confirming provider pins in modules: provider.aws = "~> 4.3.0" across modules so we shouldn't get a provider upgrade mid-apply.

bob_g: a couple Qs: (1) Are we doing a canary for the routing change, or will it be global? (2) What triggers an automatic rollback?

dmitri: plan is serial, but for routing we do an AZ-level canary: apply to us-west-2a first (low-traffic AZ), monitor 5m, then roll the rest. Rollback trigger: error rate >2% or spike in latency >60% vs baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.

alice.k: state lock TTL? If apply hangs how do we force unlock?

infra-bot: state lock TTL set to 60m for this run. To force unlock (only after confirming no active apply): `terraform force-unlock LOCK_ID` (run from ops bastion). See runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/tf-force-unlock.

carla: adding the exact canary commands here for clarity:
```bash
# apply VPC to canary AZ only
cd infra/networking
terraform workspace select release-2026-03-20
terraform plan -var='apply_az=us-west-2a' -out=canary.plan
terraform apply canary.plan
```

bob_g: perfect. How are we pinning module versions? Need to avoid accidental module roll forward during this release.

carla: modules in registry referenced by exact version in module sources, e.g. `source = "git::https://git.redwood/modules/vpc.git?ref=v1.6.2"`. No floats in this release.

emily: small reminder — add a short note in the release notes about the IAM role additions (service-account -> role mapping changed). I can draft the blurb if someone drops the affected role names here.

dmitri: roles changed: `svc-data-ingest-role`, `svc-metrics-exporter-role`. Emily — thanks, please include that.

deploy-bot: locking remote state and starting first apply (networking/canary: us-west-2a). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/1857502468/net-canary.

bob_g: monitoring hooks set: grafana dashboard pinned, synthetic hit every 10s for canary endpoints. Alerting rule configured to fire if 5xx rate >2% or p95 latency >600ms.

alice.k: if we need to rollback, playbook is: 1) pause all new traffic to changed route, 2) terraform apply revert plan (revert commit hash abc123), 3) open incident and notify @oncall. Quick command to generate revert plan:
```bash
git checkout abc123
cd infra/networking
terraform plan -destroy -out=revert.plan # or plan against previous state as appropriate
terraform apply revert.plan
```

dmitri: noted. We'll wait for canary window (start 23:05 UTC). If canary passes at 23:10, proceed to remaining AZs. If any alert within 5 minutes, abort and run rollback.

infra-bot: apply completed (canary) — no errors, no new 5xx spikes in first 6m. Proceed?

carla: proceeding with remaining AZs now. Pushing sequential applies with short pauses between AZs.

deploy-bot: all networking applies complete. Next: IAM apply queued (23:12 UTC). Plan: https://ci.redwood/plan/1857502468/iam.

emily: updated CHANGELOG with entries for the routing change and IAM role additions. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/432.

bob_g: quick check — are service accounts for exporter role covered by tight assume-role policy? We tested in staging — ok.

carla: yes — policy update included. Verified in staging; documented in PR description.

dmitri: IAM apply in progress. Will monitor for any auth failures reported by services. If errors trend up, we'll revert the IAM commit (hash def456).

infra-bot: IAM apply finished. No failed API calls observed in the 10m post-apply window.

dmitri: rolling final service route changes now. ETA 5m. Thanks everyone for the quick responses. If anything odd pops up, tag @oncall and escalate. :thumbsup:

alice.k: unlocking state now that run finished cleanly. Great work. :tada:
